title: Discover LAN and localhost A2A peers and add them with a fingerprint prompt
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Scan the LAN and known localhost ports for agent cards, verify the card, and add the peer after a one-time fingerprint confirmation (TOFU). Tests zc_peer_discovery_*.
